TS0310001.message: The embedded Hazelcast member could not start.
TS0310001.solution: Another process may already be using the member port; free it, or set tapstate.hz.member-port to one that is free, then restart.

TS0310002.message: The managed Cloud startup configuration is incomplete.
TS0310002.solution: Set tapstate.cloud.base-url, tapstate.cloud.token, tapstate.cloud.atlas-uri, and tapstate.cloud.cluster-id together, or remove all four, including any CLUSTER_ID alias, for on-prem mode.

TS0310003.message: The managed Cloud base URL is not a valid absolute HTTP(S) URL.
TS0310003.solution: Set tapstate.cloud.base-url to the Global Control Plane origin without credentials, a query, or a fragment.

TS0310004.message: The managed Cloud metadata URI is not a valid MongoDB connection string.
TS0310004.solution: Set tapstate.cloud.atlas-uri to a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection string with an explicit database name short enough for the deployment-owned operator and views databases.

TS0310005.message: The packaged Web deployment metadata is invalid: {reason}.
TS0310005.solution: Rebuild the distribution with one supported Web deployment profile and its matching complete Web payload.

TS0310006.message: The packaged Web profile `{profile}` does not match the configured runtime mode `{mode}`.
TS0310006.solution: Use the Cloud distribution with all four Cloud settings, or the on-prem distribution with every Cloud setting and CLUSTER_ID alias removed.

TS0310007.message: The packaged Web Cloud Console URL is invalid.
TS0310007.solution: Rebuild Cloud Web metadata with an absolute ASCII HTTPS Console URL without credentials, a fragment, or control characters; omit this URL from on-prem metadata.

TS0310008.message: Managed Cloud mode requires its metadata store.
TS0310008.solution: Remove tapstate.store.mongo.enabled=false and supply the assigned Cloud Atlas metadata URI.

TS0310009.message: The managed Cloud view store `{store}` conflicts with this deployment configuration.
TS0310009.solution: Preserve the conflicting resource and align the deployment with its assigned view database. All Cluster members must use the same connection settings.

TS0310010.message: The Cloud status sender switch is not a valid boolean.
TS0310010.solution: Set SDK_STATUS_SENDER_ENABLED to true or false.

TS0310011.message: Cloud status reporting cannot be enabled in on-prem mode.
TS0310011.solution: Disable SDK_STATUS_SENDER_ENABLED or provide the complete managed Cloud configuration.

TS0310012.message: Cloud status reporting was enabled without its SDK integration.
TS0310012.solution: Install the SDK-backed reporter integration before enabling SDK_STATUS_SENDER_ENABLED.

TS0310013.message: Cloud connector `{connector}` failed its required startup check: {reason}.
TS0310013.solution: Restore the matching release, lock, and licenses; repair the stored artifact or plugin cache if mismatched, then confirm every connector can register and load.

TS0310014.message: The cluster discovery configuration is invalid: {detail}.
TS0310014.solution: Choose one explicit discovery mode and provide all inputs required by that mode.

TS0310015.message: Cluster discovery requires an explicit stable cluster id.
TS0310015.solution: Set tapstate.cluster.id to the same stable value on every member.

TS0310016.message: The configured cluster id is not a valid stable identity.
TS0310016.solution: Use a non-blank cluster id that contains no colon.

TS0310017.message: Configured cluster id `{configured}` does not match stored cluster id `{stored}`.
TS0310017.solution: Point every member at the intended control store and configure its stored cluster id.

TS0310018.message: The selected cluster profile and bootstrap member count are not a supported combination.
TS0310018.solution: Use single with discovery none, process-failure-only with 2 members, or production-ha with at least 3 members.

TS0310019.message: The member heartbeat settings cannot detect failure safely.
TS0310019.solution: Use whole-second positive durations and set maximum-no-heartbeat longer than heartbeat-interval.

TS0310020.message: Cluster discovery requires an explicit stable node id.
TS0310020.solution: Set tapstate.cluster.node-id to a value that remains stable across restarts and is unique in the cluster.

TS0310021.message: Cluster discovery requires an absolute HTTP(S) control advertise URL naming a host other machines can reach.
TS0310021.solution: Set tapstate.control.advertise-url to the URL other members and clients can reach.

TS0310022.message: The Hazelcast member bind address is not valid for the selected discovery mode.
TS0310022.solution: Keep 127.0.0.1 with discovery mode none, or set a routable IP address of this host for cluster mode; a host name is not accepted.

TS0310023.message: The node-session lease lifetime must be positive.
TS0310023.solution: Set tapstate.cluster.node-session-ttl to a positive duration.

TS0310024.message: The node-session renewal interval must be positive and shorter than its lease lifetime.

TS0310025.message: The workload-claim lease must be positive.
TS0310025.solution: Set tapstate.cluster.workload-claim-ttl to a positive duration.

TS0310026.message: The workload-claim renewal interval must be positive and shorter than its lease.

TS0310027.message: Cluster discovery requires the Mongo-backed coordination store.
TS0310027.solution: Enable the Mongo store and configure it as a replica set before starting a cluster member.

TS0310028.message: Stable node id `{nodeId}` is already held by another live process.
TS0310028.solution: Use a unique node id or wait for the previous node-session lease to expire.

TS0310029.message: The member lost its reserved node session during startup.
TS0310029.solution: Restore coordination-store reachability and resolve any competing process using this node id before restarting.

TS0310030.message: This embedded Web artifact is for local development and requires explicit confirmation.
TS0310030.solution: For an intended development environment, set tapstate.local-development.enabled=true; otherwise use a release artifact.

TS0310031.message: The development Web artifact is invalid: {reason}.
TS0310031.solution: Rebuild the intended supported development profile or use a verified release artifact.

TS0310032.message: Choose either CONFIG component preparation or one migration inspection mode.
TS0310032.solution: Run CONFIG component preparation and migration inspection separately.
